A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TabTrim study. Text and visual inspection support comparison of the main text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices. Appendices A–D are retained; v2 adds Appendix E.

before.justification: Section 3 and Appendix C report original TabTrim benchmark evaluations, ablations, scaling experiments, error analysis, and token-consumption results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the main benchmark comparisons and appendix sensitivity, error, and compression analyses.

M1.justification: Section 2 retains the same SQL-derived trajectories, supervised and preference training, loss-aware verifier, and parallel beam-search procedure. Appendix implementation material does not change the method.

E1.justification: Training still uses WikiSQL and SQUALL; evaluation still covers WikiTQ, TabFact, and TableBench with the same tasks. Benchmark mentions in the new related-work paragraph do not constitute additional evaluated coverage.

E2.justification: The Table 1 baselines, Figure 3 hardness comparators, Figure 5 Best-of-N comparison, and Table 5 Qwen3/Table-R1 reasoners are unchanged. New Appendix E citations do not add evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: Section 3.1 and Appendix B retain the same sample counts, metrics, model configurations, training settings, and GPT-4o-mini answerer. Default search remains beam width and branching factor 2, with maximum depth 4.

E4.justification: The hardness, component-ablation, search-scaling, plug-and-play, and cost analyses are retained. Appendix C still contains the same correction-weight and recall-bias sensitivity studies, 100-failure error analysis, and pruning-effectiveness analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions' Appendix B.1 reports average accuracy over three runs with different random seeds and standard deviations within one percentage point. No uncertainty-reporting or statistical procedure changes are documented.

E6.justification: Reported results match across versions. Table 1 retains TabTrim-8B's 79.4% WikiTQ accuracy, 91.2% TabFact accuracy, and 73.5% average versus Table-Critic's 70.3%. Ablation, scaling, cost, sensitivity, error, and compression results also remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(9) and Appendix A's SQL-transformation, trajectory, and canonical-cell definitions are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: gold-trajectory supervision, reliable verification, parallel pruning search, and state-of-the-art performance. The reported 73.5% average and 3.2-point baseline advantage remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations of critical-data preservation, search benefits, downstream reasoning errors, and deployment efficiency are retained. The limitation concerning evaluation at 4B and 8B scales and the cautions about incorrect outputs are unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendices A, B, and D retain the same SQL-processing details, hyperparameters, eight A100 40GB GPUs, training examples, and answerer prompt. No code or data access information is added or revised.

R1.justification: v2 adds Appendix E, a short LLM-reasoning overview, and fourteen references covering multimodal, chart, mathematical, web-agent, and structured reasoning. This broadens background coverage while leaving Section 4's focused comparison with prior pruning approaches unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds an acknowledgment, the short Appendix E, and a corresponding-author marker for Dong Jin, alongside citation-suffix adjustments. The main narrative and existing appendix prose otherwise remain unchanged after matching relocated material.

P2.justification: Figure 1 receives small drawing and spacing adjustments while retaining its explanatory content. The expanded bibliography and Appendix E reflow appendix tables and examples. No empirical figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: Appendix E broadens general background without deepening the focused comparison with competing pruning methods. The technical exposition, empirical support, reproducibility information, and limitations remain unchanged. Together with the limited illustration, attribution, and layout edits, this leaves overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
